rotation.title: Photometric lightcurve and rotation period of Himalia (Jupiter VI)
rotation.evidence: DLR author-repository abstract: combined independent CCD datasets from0.35m/1.23m telescopes, replacing historical~9.5h phasing. Full methods/raw lightcurve not available from repository; direct publisher HTTP403 response retained, not a paper hash.
rotation.rights: DLR record says not open access; no CC licence or paper-figure reuse asserted.
rotation.limits: Synodic photometric period is not a sidereal pole solution or dated longitude registration. Short spin differs from orbital period; no permanent Jupiterface/locking/terrain calibration adopted.
